**Stable ID:** `DATA-06.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 06 Provenance, quality, bias and reproducibility

Record published representativeness, bias and quality analyses as attributed evidence with scope and method.

## Deliverables

- Evidence model for bias and quality findings
- Scope and method requirements

## Canonical artifact paths

- `schemas/provenance.schema.json`
- `docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each finding cites a published analysis with its method

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Findings record who measured, how and on which version
- [ ] Author-reported and third-party findings are distinguished
- [ ] No aggregate quality score is computed

## Non-goals

- Running bias audits
- Ranking datasets by quality

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-06.03.T1` Define evidence model
  - [ ] `DATA-06.03.T1.S1` Define finding fields
  - [ ] `DATA-06.03.T1.S2` Define measurer and method fields
- [ ] `DATA-06.03.T2` Validate
  - [ ] `DATA-06.03.T2.S1` Add attribution checks
  - [ ] `DATA-06.03.T2.S2` Add tests

- Blocked by `DATA-06.01` Collection provenance documentation

- Independent dataset research reviewer
